## Information
NETTA mains-powered cluster string lights are suitable for indoor and outdoor use and provide a bright decorative lighting effect for Christmas and other occasions. Featuring warm white and cool white lighting, multiple lighting modes with memory function and a convenient automatic timer, these lights are easy to install and operate. The dark green cable blends naturally with Christmas trees and outdoor greenery, making the lights ideal for Christmas displays, parties, weddings, gardens and other seasonal decorations.
CHRISTMAS LIGHTS: Let your tree shine brighter with this set of NETTA LED Cool White Christmas Cluster Lights that feature 480 beaming bulbs. These lustrous lights are sure to add a sparkle to your home or a glimmer to your garden over the festive season by enhancing the traditional Christmas theme. Not only are they perfect for Christmas, but they are ideal for any outdoor gathering or for serving a desirable decoration for parties and events. 8 HOURS ON TIMER SETTING: The timer function allows your lights to turn automatically when it gets dark. To activate the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns green. You will then be able to select your preferred lighting mode and the lights will remain on for 8 hours and turn off for 16 automatically. To turn off the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns white. 8 FUNCTIONS WITH MEMORY: This set of multifunctional string lights features 8 lighting modes to choose from, including Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash. The different lighting effects are controlled by a button on the plug adapter which make it easier than ever to achieve your desired lighting effects. SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: These lights are extra safe due to the low-voltage, mains-powered UK plug with a 31V low voltage adapter, which is IP44 rated, meaning that you can use this product both indoors and outdoors.
